Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

**About Our Contract Worker Program**

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

### **Role Overview**

Zoox is looking for a Software Engineering contract student worker to join our Mobile Apps Engineering team. In this role, you will help build and improve the CI/CD pipelines and tooling that our engineers use to build, test, and ship Zoox's iOS and Android rider apps. You will work closely with senior engineers to make our development and release process faster, more reliable, and more secure, so that every update reaches our riders with confidence.

### **Responsibilities**

* Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that compile, test, and package our iOS and Android applications.
* Automate repetitive build and release tasks, such as versioning, code signing, and distribution to internal testers via TestFlight and Google Play.
* Improve build speed and reliability by investigating pipeline failures, flaky tests, and bottlenecks.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Add automated quality checks (unit tests, linting, static analysis) that catch issues before they reach riders.
* [placeholder]
* Create dashboards and alerts that give the team visibility into build health and release status.
* Write clear documentation so engineers can easily understand and use our tooling.

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Collaborate with mobile, cloud, and release engineering teams across Zoox to learn how software moves from a pull request to a rider's phone.
* Currently pursuing or has obtained a BS / MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Ruby, TypeScript, Bash, Kotlin, or Swift).
* Basic understanding of Git and version control workflows.

### **Program Requirements**

* Comfort working from the command line on macOS or Linux.
* Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
* Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an eagerness to learn from feedback.
* Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
* Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week.
* Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
* Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

**Closing**

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Part-Time Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

www.mustdoadmin.com, owned by NNRoad Inc., is an early-stage startup. Our clients, their employees and our account managers all work through one web portal.

We are a small team building that portal now, and we are hiring our first engineer to own it end to end.

You will be the engineer responsible for the MustDoAdmin portal: you build it, ship it and keep it running. That means writing and maintaining the application, deploying it, and operating the servers, databases and security behind it. You will work directly with the founder and our account managers, who use the portal every day. As our first engineer, you will help decide how the product is built, not just build what is specified.

Development and maintenance

* Build new features across the stack: web front end, back-end services and APIs, from a clickable design to production.

* Maintain and improve the existing code: fix bugs, refactor, write tests and keep dependencies current.

* Build and maintain integrations with the systems our clients use, such as payroll platforms, accounting software and e-signature services.

* Build the portal's AI features, such as checking uploaded documents and pre-filling forms, using cloud or locally hosted models.

Deployment

* Own the release process: version control, code review, automated builds and tests (CI/CD), staging and production environments.

* Ship changes safely and often, with a tested way to roll back.

Operations: servers, databases and security

* Run and monitor the servers and cloud services the portal runs on; plan capacity and keep costs under control.

* Administer the databases: schema changes, backups, restore tests, performance tuning.

* Secure the system and the sensitive data in it (personal details, pay and bank information): access control, multi-factor sign-in, encryption, patching, logging and alerting.

* Respond to incidents, find the root cause and fix it for good.

* Keep clear documentation of how the system is built, deployed and run, so that it does not depend on any one person's memory.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Algorithm Researcher
jobs.description:
DawnSecurity is building a next-generation cybersecurity platform whose core is a hard applied-research problem: making trustworthy, explainable decisions from data that is sparse, relational, and adversarially influenced. You will work directly under our VP of Data Science, turning research questions into validated algorithms that ship.

### **What you'll do**

* Take ownership of research problems end-to-end: literature review, hypothesis, prototype, empirical validation, shadow-mode evaluation, and handoff to production.
* Design statistical models for sparse, high-cardinality event data — probability estimation, smoothing and backoff, calibration, and drift handling.
* Develop scoring methods over graph-structured data: hierarchies, peer structures, and entity relationships.
* Build synthetic data generation and negative-sampling strategies where labeled examples don't exist.
* Harden models against manipulation: reason about how an adversary could influence training data, and design defenses.
* Make model outputs explainable by construction — every score must decompose into a statement a domain expert can verify.
* Evaluate rigorously: design metrics, calibration audits, and shadow-mode comparisons that decide whether an approach ships or dies.
* Contribute to invention disclosures when your work produces novel, patentable mechanisms.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Required Qualifications**

* MSc or PhD in a quantitative field (statistics, CS/ML, applied math, physics, or similar).
* Deep grounding in probabilistic modeling and statistics — you can reason about estimators, uncertainty, and calibration, not just fit models.
* Demonstrated research ability: publications, a strong thesis, or shipped algorithms you designed from scratch.
* Experience working with limited or no labeled data: weak supervision, synthetic data, self-supervision, or unsupervised methods.
* Graph modeling experience: graph ML, network analysis, or probabilistic models over relational structure — our data is inherently graph-shaped.
* Strong Python and solid engineering habits — your prototypes are reproducible and one step from production, not throwaway notebooks.
* Intellectual honesty: you kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, and you can tell noise from signal.

### **Strong Advantages**

* Background in adversarial ML, robustness, or an adversarial application domain (security, fraud, abuse).
* Work with language-model-based pipelines under statistical quality controls.
* Familiarity with information-theoretic methods (e.g., surprisal-based scoring) or language-modeling techniques applied outside NLP.
* Experience with explainability methods or calibrated scoring in high-stakes decision systems.
* Prior patents or invention disclosures.
